title: Fill the Type Hints
story: Type hints tell readers what goes in and what comes out.
goal: Add the right types so the program prints 5.

tests.label: Type hints on a, b and the result

hints: Both inputs are whole numbers, and so is the result.
The type of a whole number is int.
socratic: Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what did the blank teach you in “Fill the Type Hints”?
